turns.user: Which published cement pastes have a plastic viscosity of 20 Pa.s or less together with a mini-slump flow diameter of at least 180 mm?
turns.text:
I’ll search the published-mix records for cement pastes matching both thresholds, then report the analogue mixes and their source details.
The database contains **100 paste mixes from 12 papers** meeting both thresholds: plastic viscosity ≤20 Pa·s and mini-slump flow diameter ≥180 mm.

| Year | Published study | Matching mixes |
|---|---|---:|
| 2020 | [Calcium sulfoaluminate cement paste with supplementary cementitious materials](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118234) | 16 |
| 2020 | [Nanoclays in SCC pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118285) | 10 |
| 2020 | [One-part alkali-activated slag/glass powder pastes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.120381) | 1 |
| 2020 | [Alkali-activated fly ash/slag pastes](https://doi.org/10.21809/rilemtechlett.2020.123) | 2 |
| 2021 | [SCMs and water-to-binder ratio in calcium sulfoaluminate cement paste](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.powtec.2021.04.027) | 12 |
| 2021 | [Nano-silica modified cement-based materials](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmats.2021.712551) | 17 |
| 2022 | [Shrinkage-mitigating materials in flowable and thixotropic cement paste](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2022.104686) | 11 |
| 2022 | [Superabsorbent polymer in natural hydraulic lime paste](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mtcomm.2022.105064) | 2 |
| 2023 | [Rheology control of self-consolidating earth concrete](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.powtec.2023.118561) | 18 |
| 2024 | [GGBFS in recycled-concrete-powder geopolymer](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2024.137190) | 1 |
| 2024 | [PCE and APAM in cement paste](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2024.e03895) | 1 |
| 2025 | [Calcined kaolinite and mechanosynthesis in self-consolidating earth paste](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.141380) | 9 |

The database’s **paste** category also includes alkali-activated, lime, and earth-based pastes. For the 2020 calcium sulfoaluminate study, viscosity values are marked author-calculated; the flow diameters are reported values.

input.sql:
SELECT m.mix_uid, m.mix_id, m.name_in_paper, m.system_type, m.w_b_reported, p.title, p.authors, p.year, p.doi,
       MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='plastic_viscosity' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END) AS plastic_viscosity_Pa_s,
       MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END) AS mini_slump_diameter_mm,
       MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='plastic_viscosity' THEN o.value_kind END) AS viscosity_value_kind,
       MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' THEN o.value_kind END) AS slump_value_kind,
       MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='plastic_viscosity' THEN o.source_type END) AS viscosity_source_type,
       MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' THEN o.source_type END) AS slump_source_type
FROM mixes m
JOIN measurements o ON o.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=m.paper_uid
WHERE m.system_type='paste'
  AND o.quantity IN ('plastic_viscosity','mini_slump_flow_diameter')
  AND o.value_canonical <> ''
GROUP BY m.mix_uid
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='plastic_viscosity' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END) <= 20
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END) >= 180
ORDER BY p.year, p.doi, m.mix_id

input.sql:
WITH matched AS (
 SELECT m.mix_uid,m.paper_uid,o.quantity,CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) v
 FROM mixes m JOIN measurements o ON o.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 WHERE m.system_type='paste' AND o.quantity IN ('plastic_viscosity','mini_slump_flow_diameter') AND o.value_canonical<>''
 GROUP BY m.mix_uid
 HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='plastic_viscosity' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END)<=20
 AND MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END)>=180
)
SELECT p.year,p.title,p.doi,COUNT(DISTINCT matched.mix_uid) AS matching_paste_mixes
FROM matched JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=matched.paper_uid
GROUP BY p.paper_uid ORDER BY p.year,p.doi
